audience: one high-school student learning neuron biophysics

dimensions.emerging: Can label a few parts but confuses roles
dimensions.developing: Labels most parts and basic functions
dimensions.strong: Uses structure to predict signaling differences

dimensions.developing: Links one cause to one effect
dimensions.proficient: Explains multi-step chains such as gradient -> permeability -> voltage
dimensions.strong: Can compare alternative mechanisms and justify which dominates

dimensions.developing: Reads axes correctly but misses meaning
dimensions.strong: Uses a graph as evidence in an explanation

dimensions.emerging: Sign, units, and arithmetic errors common
dimensions.strong: Explains what the calculation means biologically

dimensions.proficient: Gives coherent written and oral explanations
dimensions.strong: Explains clearly, concisely, and with evidence

use_guidance: Use weekly for mentor check-ins. One level difference across dimensions is normal; the target by the final presentation is mostly proficient with at least one strong evidence-based explanation.
